staging_buffer_creation_algorithm.implementation_pseudocode:
# Staging Buffer Creation - MUST be implemented exactly as specified

def create_staging_buffer(artist_output):
    """
    Extracts rendered text from Artist output and calculates metrics.
    This is the GROUND TRUTH for all QA validation.
    """
    staging_buffer = {}
    
    # K.1 Executive Summary
    k1_raw = artist_output.get('K.1', '')
    k1_text = strip_all_xml_tags(k1_raw)
    k1_text = apply_text_formatting(k1_text)
    
    staging_buffer['K.1'] = {
        'rendered_text': k1_text,
        'word_count': len(k1_text.split()),
        'char_count': len(k1_text),
        'sentence_count': count_sentences(k1_text)
    }
    
    # K.4 Headline
    k4_raw = artist_output.get('K.4', '')
    k4_text = strip_all_xml_tags(k4_raw)
    k4_text = apply_text_formatting(k4_text)
    
    staging_buffer['K.4'] = {
        'rendered_text': k4_text,
        'char_count': len(k4_text),
        'word_count': len(k4_text.split()),
        'segment_count': k4_text.count('|') + 1
    }
    
    # K.5A Bullets (array of 7)
    k5a_raw = artist_output.get('K.5A', {}).get('bullets', [])
    k5a_bullets = []
    for i, bullet_raw in enumerate(k5a_raw):
        bullet_text = strip_all_xml_tags(bullet_raw.get('text', ''))
        bullet_text = apply_text_formatting(bullet_text)
        k5a_bullets.append({
            'index': i,
            'rendered_text': bullet_text,
            'word_count': len(bullet_text.split()),
            'provenance': bullet_raw.get('provenance', 'UNKNOWN')
        })
    
    staging_buffer['K.5A'] = {
        'bullets': k5a_bullets,
        'total_bullets': len(k5a_bullets)
    }
    
    # K.5B Unify Overview
    k5b_raw = artist_output.get('K.5B', '')
    k5b_text = strip_all_xml_tags(k5b_raw)
    k5b_text = apply_text_formatting(k5b_text)
    
    staging_buffer['K.5B'] = {
        'rendered_text': k5b_text,
        'word_count': len(k5b_text.split()),
        'char_count': len(k5b_text)
    }
    
    # K.6A Bullets (array of 6)
    k6a_raw = artist_output.get('K.6A', {}).get('bullets', [])
    k6a_bullets = []
    for i, bullet_raw in enumerate(k6a_raw):
        bullet_text = strip_all_xml_tags(bullet_raw.get('text', ''))
        bullet_text = apply_text_formatting(bullet_text)
        k6a_bullets.append({
            'index': i,
            'rendered_text': bullet_text,
            'word_count': len(bullet_text.split()),
            'provenance': bullet_raw.get('provenance', 'UNKNOWN')
        })
    
    staging_buffer['K.6A'] = {
        'bullets': k6a_bullets,
        'total_bullets': len(k6a_bullets)
    }
    
    # K.6B IBM Overview
    k6b_raw = artist_output.get('K.6B', '')
    k6b_text = strip_all_xml_tags(k6b_raw)
    k6b_text = apply_text_formatting(k6b_text)
    
    staging_buffer['K.6B'] = {
        'rendered_text': k6b_text,
        'word_count': len(k6b_text.split()),
        'char_count': len(k6b_text)
    }
    
    # K.8 Competencies (array of 6)
    k8_raw = artist_output.get('K.8', {}).get('competencies', [])
    k8_comps = []
    for i, comp_raw in enumerate(k8_raw):
        title = strip_all_xml_tags(comp_raw.get('title', ''))
        description = strip_all_xml_tags(comp_raw.get('description', ''))
        combined = f"{title}: {description}"
        k8_comps.append({
            'index': i,
            'title': title,
            'description': description,
            'combined_text': combined,
            'word_count': len(combined.split()),
            'tier': comp_raw.get('tier', 'UNKNOWN')
        })
    
    staging_buffer['K.8'] = {
        'competencies': k8_comps,
        'total_competencies': len(k8_comps)
    }
    
    # K.9 Cover Letter Paragraphs (array of 3)
    k9_raw = artist_output.get('K.9', {}).get('paragraphs', [])
    k9_paras = []
    for i, para_raw in enumerate(k9_raw):
        para_text = strip_all_xml_tags(para_raw)
        para_text = apply_text_formatting(para_text)
        k9_paras.append({
            'index': i,
            'rendered_text': para_text,
            'word_count': len(para_text.split())
        })
    
    # Also store full letter
    full_letter = '\n\n'.join([p['rendered_text'] for p in k9_paras])
    
    staging_buffer['K.9'] = {
        'paragraphs': k9_paras,
        'full_letter': full_letter,
        'total_paragraphs': len(k9_paras)
    }
    
    return staging_buffer


# Helper functions
def strip_all_xml_tags(text):
    """Remove ALL XML-style tags from text"""
    import re
    # Remove tags like <K.1>, </K.1>, [SYNTHETIC], etc.
    text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\[[A-Z_]+\]', '', text)
    return text.strip()

def apply_text_formatting(text):
    """Apply final text formatting (normalize whitespace, etc.)"""
    import re
    # Normalize whitespace
    text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)
    return text.strip()

def count_sentences(text):
    """Count sentences by delimiter"""
    import re
    delimiters = re.findall(r'[.!?]', text)
    return len(delimiters)

new_correct_implementation.pseudocode:
def validate_word_count(staging_buffer, global_spec):
    """
    Validates word counts by reading ACTUAL rendered text from staging buffer.
    This function CANNOT access artist_output.
    """
    results = []
    
    # K.1 Executive Summary
    k1_rendered = staging_buffer['K.1']['rendered_text']
    k1_actual = len(k1_rendered.split())
    k1_min = global_spec['word_counts']['K.1_executive_summary']['min']  # 118
    k1_max = global_spec['word_counts']['K.1_executive_summary']['max']  # 135
    
    if k1_actual < k1_min:
        delta = k1_min - k1_actual
        preview = k1_rendered[:300]
        raise ValidationException(
            gate='VG_MANDATORY_WORD_COUNT_COMPLIANCE',
            section='K.1',
            message=f"K.1 Executive Summary FAILED\n"
                    f"Expected: {k1_min}-{k1_max} words\n"
                    f"Actual: {k1_actual} words\n"
                    f"Delta: {delta} words SHORT\n\n"
                    f"Text preview (first 300 chars):\n{preview}..."
        )
    
    if k1_actual > k1_max:
        delta = k1_actual - k1_max
        preview = k1_rendered[:300]
        raise ValidationException(
            gate='VG_MANDATORY_WORD_COUNT_COMPLIANCE',
            section='K.1',
            message=f"K.1 Executive Summary FAILED\n"
                    f"Expected: {k1_min}-{k1_max} words\n"
                    f"Actual: {k1_actual} words\n"
                    f"Delta: {delta} words LONG\n\n"
                    f"Text preview (first 300 chars):\n{preview}..."
        )
    
    results.append({
        'section': 'K.1',
        'expected': f"{k1_min}-{k1_max}",
        'actual': k1_actual,
        'status': 'PASS'
    })
    
    # K.5A Bullets (7 bullets, 28-33 words each)
    k5a_bullets = staging_buffer['K.5A']['bullets']
    k5a_min = global_spec['word_counts']['K.5A_unify_bullets']['min']  # 28
    k5a_max = global_spec['word_counts']['K.5A_unify_bullets']['max']  # 33
    
    for bullet in k5a_bullets:
        bullet_text = bullet['rendered_text']
        bullet_actual = len(bullet_text.split())
        bullet_index = bullet['index']
        
        if bullet_actual < k5a_min or bullet_actual > k5a_max:
            raise ValidationException(
                gate='VG_MANDATORY_WORD_COUNT_COMPLIANCE',
                section=f'K.5A[{bullet_index}]',
                message=f"K.5A Bullet {bullet_index} FAILED\n"
                        f"Expected: {k5a_min}-{k5a_max} words\n"
                        f"Actual: {bullet_actual} words\n\n"
                        f"Bullet text:\n{bullet_text}"
            )
        
        results.append({
            'section': f'K.5A[{bullet_index}]',
            'expected': f"{k5a_min}-{k5a_max}",
            'actual': bullet_actual,
            'status': 'PASS'
        })
    
    # K.5B Unify Overview
    k5b_rendered = staging_buffer['K.5B']['rendered_text']
    k5b_actual = len(k5b_rendered.split())
    k5b_min = global_spec['word_counts']['K.5B_unify_overview']['min']  # 28
    k5b_max = global_spec['word_counts']['K.5B_unify_overview']['max']  # 34
    
    if k5b_actual < k5b_min or k5b_actual > k5b_max:
        raise ValidationException(
            gate='VG_MANDATORY_WORD_COUNT_COMPLIANCE',
            section='K.5B',
            message=f"K.5B Unify Overview FAILED\n"
                    f"Expected: {k5b_min}-{k5b_max} words\n"
                    f"Actual: {k5b_actual} words\n\n"
                    f"Overview text:\n{k5b_rendered}"
        )
    
    results.append({
        'section': 'K.5B',
        'expected': f"{k5b_min}-{k5b_max}",
        'actual': k5b_actual,
        'status': 'PASS'
    })
    
    # K.6A Bullets (6 bullets, 24-30 words each)
    k6a_bullets = staging_buffer['K.6A']['bullets']
    k6a_min = global_spec['word_counts']['K.6A_ibm_bullets']['min']  # 24
    k6a_max = global_spec['word_counts']['K.6A_ibm_bullets']['max']  # 30
    
    for bullet in k6a_bullets:
        bullet_text = bullet['rendered_text']
        bullet_actual = len(bullet_text.split())
        bullet_index = bullet['index']
        
        if bullet_actual < k6a_min or bullet_actual > k6a_max:
            raise ValidationException(
                gate='VG_MANDATORY_WORD_COUNT_COMPLIANCE',
                section=f'K.6A[{bullet_index}]',
                message=f"K.6A Bullet {bullet_index} FAILED\n"
                        f"Expected: {k6a_min}-{k6a_max} words\n"
                        f"Actual: {bullet_actual} words\n\n"
                        f"Bullet text:\n{bullet_text}"
            )
        
        results.append({
            'section': f'K.6A[{bullet_index}]',
            'expected': f"{k6a_min}-{k6a_max}",
            'actual': bullet_actual,
            'status': 'PASS'
        })
    
    # K.6B IBM Overview
    k6b_rendered = staging_buffer['K.6B']['rendered_text']
    k6b_actual = len(k6b_rendered.split())
    k6b_min = global_spec['word_counts']['K.6B_ibm_overview']['min']  # 25
    k6b_max = global_spec['word_counts']['K.6B_ibm_overview']['max']  # 30
    
    if k6b_actual < k6b_min or k6b_actual > k6b_max:
        raise ValidationException(
            gate='VG_MANDATORY_WORD_COUNT_COMPLIANCE',
            section='K.6B',
            message=f"K.6B IBM Overview FAILED\n"
                    f"Expected: {k6b_min}-{k6b_max} words\n"
                    f"Actual: {k6b_actual} words\n\n"
                    f"Overview text:\n{k6b_rendered}"
        )
    
    results.append({
        'section': 'K.6B',
        'expected': f"{k6b_min}-{k6b_max}",
        'actual': k6b_actual,
        'status': 'PASS'
    })
    
    # K.8 Competencies (6 competencies, 24-30 words each)
    k8_comps = staging_buffer['K.8']['competencies']
    k8_min = global_spec['word_counts']['K.8_competencies']['min']  # 24
    k8_max = global_spec['word_counts']['K.8_competencies']['max']  # 30
    
    for comp in k8_comps:
        comp_text = comp['combined_text']
        comp_actual = len(comp_text.split())
        comp_index = comp['index']
        comp_title = comp['title']
        
        if comp_actual < k8_min or comp_actual > k8_max:
            raise ValidationException(
                gate='VG_MANDATORY_WORD_COUNT_COMPLIANCE',
                section=f'K.8[{comp_index}]',
                message=f"K.8 Competency {comp_index} FAILED\n"
                        f"Title: {comp_title}\n"
                        f"Expected: {k8_min}-{k8_max} words\n"
                        f"Actual: {comp_actual} words\n\n"
                        f"Combined text:\n{comp_text}"
            )
        
        results.append({
            'section': f'K.8[{comp_index}]',
            'expected': f"{k8_min}-{k8_max}",
            'actual': comp_actual,
            'status': 'PASS'
        })
    
    # K.9 Cover Letter Paragraphs (3 paragraphs, 85-100 words each)
    k9_paras = staging_buffer['K.9']['paragraphs']
    k9_min = global_spec['word_counts']['K.9_cover_letter']['min']  # 85
    k9_max = global_spec['word_counts']['K.9_cover_letter']['max']  # 100
    
    for para in k9_paras:
        para_text = para['rendered_text']
        para_actual = len(para_text.split())
        para_index = para['index']
        
        if para_actual < k9_min or para_actual > k9_max:
            raise ValidationException(
                gate='VG_MANDATORY_WORD_COUNT_COMPLIANCE',
                section=f'K.9[{para_index}]',
                message=f"K.9 Cover Letter Paragraph {para_index} FAILED\n"
                        f"Expected: {k9_min}-{k9_max} words\n"
                        f"Actual: {para_actual} words\n\n"
                        f"Paragraph text:\n{para_text}"
            )
        
        results.append({
            'section': f'K.9[{para_index}]',
            'expected': f"{k9_min}-{k9_max}",
            'actual': para_actual,
            'status': 'PASS'
        })
    
    return ValidationResult(success=True, results=results)

✅ Staging buffer word_count calculated via len(rendered_text.split())
✅ Validation functions receive staging_buffer parameter ONLY
✅ MANUAL_001 test passes (human counts K.1 in Word, matches QA Report)
✅ Zero mismatches across all manual verification tests
✅ QA Report Section 0.6 shows ✅ for all subsections
✅ Error messages include rendered text preview
✅ User can trust QA Report word counts without manual checking
CRITICAL_SUCCESS_CRITERIA.definition_of_done: Human manually verifies K.1 word count in Microsoft Word. The count EXACTLY matches QA Report Section 1. This proves staging buffer is being used.

WHAT_WE_LEARNED.lesson_1: Specifications are not implementations - always verify code actually does what spec says
WHAT_WE_LEARNED.lesson_2: False-pass validation is worse than no validation - creates false confidence
WHAT_WE_LEARNED.lesson_3: User-reported bugs always trump automated tests - if user says counts are wrong, believe them
WHAT_WE_LEARNED.lesson_4: Manual verification is mandatory for critical metrics - never trust 100% automated QA
WHAT_WE_LEARNED.lesson_5: Enforce data source constraints at function signature level - don't rely on discipline
WHAT_WE_LEARNED.lesson_6: The original v1.6.0 staging_buffer_v2 was architecture fiction - never implemented
WHAT_WE_LEARNED.lesson_7: This patch is useless without actual implementation code - provide pseudocode developers can follow
